in_marathi.name: Balbir
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Brave as a Lion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balbir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balbir is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bal' (brave) and 'Bir' (lion). The name signifies being courageous like a lion. In Hindu mythology, Balbir is a name of Lord Hanuman, who is revered for his bravery and unwavering devotion.
